blurb: Mantissa 3.7.2 is an open-source Rust UCI chess engine by Jeremy Wright, begun in 2021 to explore chess programming and Rust. It combines magic bitboards and a selective alpha-beta search with an embedded 768 -> 256x2 -> 1 perspective-mirrored NNUE trained on Mantissa self-play games. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper with WebAssembly 128-bit SIMD.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build with fixed-width 128-bit SIMD (+simd128) for the embedded NNUE; Hash capped for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards with Zobrist position hashing.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Negamax alpha-beta search with zero-window probes, aspiration windows, and quiescence search.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Reduced-depth null-move pruning at non-PV nodes.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Depth reductions on late moves combined with futility and delta pruning.

features.label: Late Move Pruning
features.implementation: Move-count pruning of late quiet moves at shallow search depths.

features.label: Reverse Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Static evaluation cutoff above beta at shallow depths.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Exclusion search extending singular transposition-table moves.

features.label: Multi-Cut
features.implementation: Early beta cutoff when multiple reduced moves fail high.

features.label: SEE Pruning
features.implementation: Static exchange evaluation for capture pruning in quiescence search and move ordering.

features.label: Countermove & Follow-up History
features.implementation: Butterfly history paired with countermove and follow-up histories, killers, and countermove heuristic.

features.label: Embedded NNUE
features.implementation: Perspective-mirrored 768 -> 256x2 -> 1 floating-point neural network trained on Mantissa self-play games.
